Monitor widgets load completed displays independently: an earlier count60 screenshot showed direct62/delayed3, a 59-frame visible difference. UI snapshots are not an atomic timing oracle. Native knob dragging and context-menu parameter entry were not successfully exercised; actual SDK parameter, JSON and undo/redo paths were independently checked.
diagnosticLimits: Snapshots copied only from RVX diagnostic lines. Quantiles and error/deadline counters are cumulative since each worker run started, not separately reset per setting; run2 includes 15 -> Initialize1 -> Undo15. frameBytes is actual unique retained frame and CV storage at that snapshot, not the conservative allocation reservation, process RSS or a leak proof. sourceSequence is an I/O-source metric and remains zero in this internal-generator fixture. Histogram buckets are 0.05ms. No saturated samples in these snapshots.
privacy: No raw host log, settings, hardware identifiers, license, screenshot, audio or external source content is included. Existing user-edited patch/process and normal Rack profile were left unchanged.
